verdict.rationale: The pack confirms that Sentry has an Alerts product, Slack and PagerDuty notification integrations, and email alerts, so routing alerts to all three destinations is evidenced. The Alerts, Slack and PagerDuty items are only page titles, though, so per-rule conditions and routing filters are not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of per-rule thresholds (new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count), routing filters by project/environment/severity, substantive alert-rule documentation content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
